cmd:
cat > /tmp/timing.sh <<'EOF'
exec > /tmp/synctime.log 2>&1
PY=/root/unitex-finrep/.venv/bin/python
cd /root/unitex-finrep
s=$(date +%s); $PY /root/direct-sync/expeditor_direct_sync.py >/tmp/a.log 2>&1; e=$?; echo "експедитор: $(( $(date +%s)-s ))с rc=$e"
s=$(date +%s); $PY /root/direct-sync/maersk_track_sync.py >/tmp/b.log 2>&1; e=$?; echo "maersk: $(( $(date +%s)-s ))с rc=$e"; tail -3 /tmp/b.log
s=$(date +%s); $PY /root/direct-sync/cosco_track_sync.py >/tmp/c.log 2>&1; e=$?; echo "cosco: $(( $(date +%s)-s ))с rc=$e"; tail -3 /tmp/c.log
echo TIMING_DONE
EOF
rm -f /tmp/synctime.log; nohup bash /tmp/timing.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo 'запущено у фоні'
